use_when.text: Use Medium in the Back Office header, next to the notifications Icon Button.
Use Small in lists and table rows, and Large on profile pages.
Use Image when the person has a photo, and Initials when they do not.
Write two letters, first and last name, such as AC.
Crop photos to a square so they fill the circle.

dont_use_when.text: Do not use it for venues or items.
Do not put more than two letters in Initials.
Do not stretch a photo out of shape.
Do not add a border or shadow to the avatar.
Do not recolour it outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Use the same size for every avatar in one list.
Show the person’s name nearby, so the avatar is not the only way to identify them.

placement.text: Back Office header, next to the notifications Icon Button, at Size Medium.
Lists and table rows at Size Small, and profile pages at Size Large.

pairs_with.how: Type Image renders the user Icon, sized sm, lg or xl by Size

a11y.text: Renders a <span> with role="img"; aria-label is a required prop (the person's full name).
The Initials text is aria-hidden="true", so the aria-label is the only name read.
Type Image renders the user Icon, which is aria-hidden by default.
Give it alt text or an aria-label with the full name, such as "Aye Chan".
If it opens a menu, make it a button, such as "Account menu for Aye Chan".
When the name is already written next to it, mark it aria-hidden="true".
Small avatars are 32 px. Give them a 44 px hit area when they are clickable.
Initials on the yellow are above 4.5:1 in both modes.
